Vacancy for Fire Safety Officer
Monday, 05 October 2026
176 Hits
Secretary, Kasturba Health Society, Sevagram Dist. Wardha (MS) invites applications for the post of Fire Safety Officer in the prescribed proforma
(Download the application form here)
. The application along with all certified photocopies of academic and experience certificates should reach to the office of: The Secretary, Kasturba Health Society, Sevagram Dist. Wardha (MS), 442102 latest by 25/10/2026.
Essential Qualification
The candidate must possess any one of the following qualifications:
Degree in Fire Engineering awarded by the National Fire Service College (NFSC), Ministry of Home Affairs, Government of India.
OR
Degree in Fire Engineering / Fire & Safety Engineering from a recognized University/Institution
or
Equivalent.
Essential Experience
Minimum
5 years of relevant professional experience
in Fire Safety, Fire Protection and Emergency Management.
Preference shall be given to candidates having experience in:
Government/Semi-Government hospitals or Medical Colleges;
Large hospitals of 500 beds or more;
High-rise/institutional buildings;
Fire detection and alarm systems;
Hydrant, sprinkler and fire suppression systems;
Fire pumps, fire water tanks and fire protection installations;
Fire risk assessment and fire safety inspections;
Emergency evacuation and disaster management;
Conducting fire drills/mock drills;
Fire safety training and awareness programmes;
Statutory fire safety compliance and liaison with Fire & Emergency Services authorities.
Desirable Qualification / Training
Specialised training in Fire Prevention, Fire Protection and Life Safety;
Training from National Fire Service College / Maharashtra Fire & Emergency Services / other Government-recognized fire training institution;
Knowledge of National Building Code (NBC), applicable Maharashtra Fire Prevention and Life Safety Measures legislation and relevant fire safety standards;
Experience in healthcare fire safety and evacuation of non-ambulatory patients shall be preferred.
Salary:
As admissible under the rules of Kasturba Health Society.
Age:
Between 18-38 years for open category/ between 18-43 years for reserved category.
Note:
1) The application so received shall be screened by the Society and shortlisted candidates shall be intimated about the date, time and place of interview.
2) Age and experience can be relaxed for exceptional and deserving candidate.
3) Society reserves the right of selection or appointment.
4) No TA and DA will be paid for attending the interview.
5) Decision of Selection Committee will be final.
